description:
Corresponding genes of a Brassica gene in other genome assemblies: 32 Brassica assemblies distributed by BnaOmics: B. napus Darmor-bzh v10, Express 617, NY7, the eight HZAU genomes (Gangan, Zheyou 73, Shengli, Tapidor, Quinta, Westar, No2127; ZS11 is the BnIR genome) and the HZAU pan-genome reference, ZS11, Westar and Laurentian ONT assemblies, ZS4-2, ZS9, HTR001, Zhongyou 821 and ZS11 (FAFU); B. carinata zd-1; B. juncea AU213 and tumida v2; B. nigra YZ12151, Ni100 v2, C2; B. oleracea HDEM, JZS v2, Korso, OX-heart; B. rapa Chiifu v3.0 and v2.5, Z1 v2 (assembly ids like Bnapus_Darmor_v10, Bnapus_Westar_ONT, Brapa_Chiifu_v3; B. napus genes are matched to Ensembl Darmor v4.1, B. rapa to Chiifu, B. oleracea to TO1000, B. juncea and B. nigra to Ensembl B. juncea, B. carinata to B. juncea + B. oleracea). gene: an Ensembl Plants gene
ID or name ('BnaC09g12820D', 'GSBRNA2T00000001001', 'Bra000001', 'Bo1g001000') or a gene ID of one of these assemblies (returns its Ensembl match, then the
other assemblies). Matches are DIAMOND best protein hits to the Ensembl gene (identity, query coverage, and
whether the pair is a reciprocal best hit); each gene has its location and a genome browser link. assembly
restricts to one assembly id; reciprocal_only keeps reciprocal best hits.
name: gene_in_assemblies
